properties.note: This facility list covers Greater Jaipur Municipal Corporation's TEMPORARY winter 'rain basera' night-shelter camps (cold-wave season, reported Dec 2021), NOT the permanent NULM Shelter for Urban Homeless (SUH) stock. The permanent SUH tier is only publicly known in AGGREGATE for Jaipur (total capacity ~1,875, per the Justice Kailash Gambhir Committee report on urban homeless shelters, 2017, as cited in Citizen Matters, 'Rain, chill or heatwave, homeless poor have few places to turn to'). A facility-level list of Jaipur's permanent SUH shelters (with individual names/addresses/capacities) could not be located publicly in this research pass; 14 permanent shelter locations are referenced in Rajasthan Patrika reporting by generic site-type only (hospital grounds, railway stations, temples), without individual capacities or addresses, so they are not represented as separate features here to avoid inventing site records.
properties.aggregate_source: Justice Kailash Gambhir Committee report on shelters in India (2017), as cited in https://citizenmatters.in/india-urban-homeless-poor-shelters/
